events.title: CasperID Global Hackathon 2026
events.description: Build the next generation of privacy-preserving applications using the MCI Algorithm. $50,000 in prizes.
events.fullContent: The CasperID Global Hackathon is our flagship developer event. We are looking for innovative solutions that leverage the MCI (Multi-Context Identity) algorithm to solve real-world privacy challenges. Whether you are building DeFi protocols, social networks, or enterprise tools, CasperID provides the root identity layer you need.

events.title: Identity Governance Summit
events.description: Join the core team to discuss the future of .cid registry and decentralized governance models.
events.fullContent: Shape the future of decentralized identity. The Identity Governance Summit brings together stakeholders, developers, and community members to vote on key protocol upgrades and the long-term roadmap of the .cid registry.

agenda.activity: Keynote: The State of Decentralized ID

events.title: Monthly Community Call #14
events.description: Product updates, roadmap reveal for Q2, and live Q&A with the engineering leads.
events.fullContent: Get the latest updates directly from the CasperID core team. We will be revealing the Q2 roadmap, demonstrating new MCI features, and answering your questions live.

events.title: ZK-Proof Workshop: Advanced MCI
events.description: Deep dive into implementing zero-knowledge proofs for enterprise identity solutions.
events.fullContent: A technical deep-dive into the mathematics and implementation of zero-knowledge proofs within the CasperID framework. Perfect for developers looking to build enterprise-grade privacy solutions.

events.title: Identity Pioneer Program v1
events.description: Our first major community onboarding event. Exclusive badges for early adopters.
events.fullContent: The Identity Pioneer Program celebrates our earliest supporters. By participating in this campaign, you earn exclusive on-chain badges that grant early access to future protocol features.
